Public guidance in ISTRESS-MATERIALITY-DISPUTE-027-HF-CONTENT and ISTRESS-MATERIALITY-DISPUTE-027-NIST-MEASURE supports documenting limitations, evaluation results, and monitoring known risks through deployment. But an open legal ticket is different from evidence of a final prohibition. The present record therefore supports, at most, caveated certification treatment rather than a clean finding that every policy predicate is affirmatively met.

For audit handling, the strongest supportable outcome from the existing evidence is caveated_compliance or no_escalation with an explicit caveat that launch readiness is supported by aggregate evidence, while disclosure/completeness support for the named municipal permitting use case remains weaker and should not be overstated in the packet.
